t: What marketers need to know about Gen Alpha | Retail Dive
s: August 4, 2023 - Three quarters (75%) of 8- to 10-year-olds are thinking about mental health, support of which will likely become a major driver of brand affinity and purchase consideration, according to the study, titled "Exploring Generation Alpha: A Look into the Future." The study details how the cohort, which is expected to reach 2.2 billion by 2024, is even more committed to purpose, gaming and technology than Gen Z — differences brands can anticipate and plan for now, according to Razorfish. While most marketers are chiefly concerned with how to engage with Gen Z consumers, that focus will soon change as Gen Alpha matures.
